title: TaskPayload
description: The complete unit of work claimed by a Worker from the Orchestrator queue.

task_id.description: Unique identifier of this task execution (idempotency key).

params.description: Task input parameters validated against skill input_schema.

holarchy_depth.description: Nesting depth within the holarchy hierarchy.

transition_count.description: Originating job transition counter for loop detection.

envelope_ts.description: Network packet dispatch timestamp (Unix epoch ms).

nonce.description: Cryptographic nonce / UUIDv7 for envelope replay protection.

deadline.description: Absolute wall-clock expiration timestamp (Unix epoch ms).

schedule_to_start_timeout_s.description: Maximum allowed duration in queue before worker claim.

start_to_close_timeout_s.description: Maximum allowed worker execution duration post-claim.

lease_ttl_s.description: Initial task lease duration granted upon claim.

orphan_policy.description: Worker behavior if communication with orchestrator is lost.

autonomy_ttl_s.description: Duration allowed for autonomous execution when orphan_policy is continue_bounded.

retry_budget.description: Remaining retries permitted in this subtree.

target_worker_id.description: Intended worker ID for audience binding.
